es: Contar una historia con contexto, causa previa, un giro, un condicional mixto y una reflexión final con wish o should have.

teaching.en: Last summer we were camping by a lake when a storm started.
teaching.es: El verano pasado estábamos acampando junto a un lago cuando empezó una tormenta.
teaching.explanationEs: Contexto: was/were + -ing para la escena y when + pasado simple para lo que la interrumpe.
segments: Last summer we were camping by
a lake when a storm started.
teaching.audioText: Last summer we were camping by a lake when a storm started.

teaching.en: We had ignored the forecast, so we weren't ready.
teaching.es: Habíamos ignorado el pronóstico, así que no estábamos preparados.
teaching.explanationEs: Causa previa: had + participio explica por qué pasó algo antes del momento que cuentas.
teaching.audioText: We had ignored the forecast, so we weren't ready.

teaching.en: Suddenly, a stranger appeared and offered us a place in his van.
teaching.es: De repente, apareció un desconocido y nos ofreció un sitio en su furgoneta.
teaching.explanationEs: El giro: suddenly + pasado simple cambia la historia.
segments: Suddenly, a stranger appeared and offered
us a place in his van.
teaching.audioText: Suddenly, a stranger appeared and offered us a place in his van.

teaching.en: If we hadn't met him, we would be sleeping in wet tents now.
teaching.es: Si no lo hubiéramos conocido, estaríamos durmiendo en tiendas de campaña mojadas ahora.
teaching.explanationEs: Condicional mixto: causa pasada (hadn't met) y resultado de hoy (would be sleeping).
segments: If we hadn't met him, we would
be sleeping in wet tents now.
teaching.audioText: If we hadn't met him, we would be sleeping in wet tents now.

teaching.en: I wish we had listened to the forecast.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + had + participio expresa arrepentimiento por algo del pasado.
teaching.audioText: I wish we had listened to the forecast.

teaching.en: The experience taught us a lesson: we should have checked the weather.
teaching.es: La experiencia nos enseñó una lección: deberíamos haber mirado el tiempo.
teaching.explanationEs: Should have + participio cierra la historia con una crítica a lo que no se hizo.
segments: The experience taught us a lesson:
we should have checked the weather.
teaching.audioText: The experience taught us a lesson: we should have checked the weather.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Estábamos cenando junto al río cuando empezó a llover.»

answer.text: We were having dinner by the river when it started to rain

feedback.es: El contexto usa was/were + -ing para la escena y when + pasado simple para el hecho que la interrumpe.

hint.es: Empieza con la escena en curso y termina con when + el hecho que la interrumpe.

prompt.es: ¿Qué oración da la causa previa de la historia?

choices.text: We weren't checking the forecast when it rained.
We hadn't checked the forecast, so we weren't ready.
We don't check the forecast, so we aren't ready.

feedback.es: La causa es anterior a la escena, por eso se usa had + participio. Las otras dos no sitúan el hecho antes del momento contado.

hint.es: La causa ocurrió antes: busca had + participio.

origin.text: Quieres explicar por qué no estaban preparados: no habían mirado el pronóstico.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no hubiera perdido el tren, ahora estaría en la playa.»

feedback.es: El resultado de hoy en un condicional mixto lleva would + verbo base.

hint.es: El resultado habla de hoy: would + verbo base.

origin.text: If I hadn't missed the train, I ___ be at the beach now.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cierra la historia con una reflexión sobre lo que pasó?

choices.text: I wish we take a map.
I wish we will take a map.
I wish we had taken a map.

feedback.es: Wish + had + participio lamenta algo pasado. Las otras dos mezclan wish con el presente o con will, que no encajan con lo ocurrido.

origin.text: Se perdieron en el bosque porque no llevaron un mapa.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con la parte de la historia que cumple.

pairs: We were walking home when it started to snow.
Suddenly, all the lights went out.
I should have brought a torch.

feedback.es: Cada frase tiene una función: la escena, el motivo anterior, el cambio inesperado y la lección final.

pairs: We were walking home when it started to snow.
Suddenly, all the lights went out.
I should have brought a torch.

prompt.es: Escribe una frase de giro con suddenly.

answer.text: Suddenly, a neighbour appeared with an umbrella.
accepted: Suddenly, a neighbour appeared with an umbrella.
A neighbour suddenly appeared with an umbrella.
Suddenly a neighbour came with an umbrella.

feedback.es: El giro se cuenta con suddenly + pasado simple: un hecho inesperado que cambia la historia.

origin.text: Giro: de repente, una vecina apareció con un paraguas.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige dónde estarían ahora sin la lesión de Tom.

choices.text: They would be by the water.
They would be in the forest.

feedback.es: El condicional mixto une la lesión pasada con hoy: sin ella, estarían ahora junto al lago, no en casa.

origin.audio: We had been walking for hours when Tom hurt his foot, so we went home by bus. If he hadn't hurt it, we would be at the lake now.

prompt.es: ¿Qué reflexión final encaja con ese arrepentimiento?

choices.text: I must have asked for help earlier.
I should have asked for help earlier.
I will ask for help earlier.

feedback.es: Should have + participio lamenta algo que no se hizo. Must have + participio deduce lo que probablemente pasó, y will ask mira al futuro.

origin.text: No pediste ayuda a tiempo y ahora te arrepientes.

prompt.es: Completa: «Estábamos jugando cuando de repente se fue la luz.»

feedback.es: When une la escena en curso con el hecho que la interrumpe.

origin.text: We were playing ___ the lights suddenly went out.

prompt.es: Escribe tu anécdota con los datos dados, de 50 a 110 palabras.

answer.text: Last Saturday, my brother and I were hiking in the forest when it started to get dark. We hadn't checked the time, so we weren't ready. Suddenly, we met a ranger, and he showed us the way back. If we hadn't met him, we would be lost now. I wish we had checked the time before we left.
accepted: Last Saturday, my brother and I were hiking in the forest when it started to get dark. We hadn't checked the time, so we weren't ready. Suddenly, we met a ranger, and he showed us the way back. If we hadn't met him, we would be lost now. I wish we had checked the time before we left.

Last Saturday, my brother and I were walking in the forest when it started to get dark. We had not looked at the time, so we were not ready. Suddenly, we found a ranger who showed us the way. If we hadn't found him, we would be lost now. I wish we had looked at the time before we left.

Yesterday my brother and I were walking in the forest when it began to get dark. We had forgotten to check the time, so we weren't ready. Suddenly, a ranger appeared and showed us the way. If it hadn't been for him, we would be lost now. I should have checked the time before we left.

feedback.es: La historia incluye contexto, causa previa, giro, condicional mixto y reflexión final, cada parte con su tiempo verbal.

origin.text: Datos: estabas de excursión en el bosque con tu hermano cuando empezó a anochecer. Causa previa: no habían mirado la hora. Giro: de repente encontraron a un guarda del bosque. Efecto de hoy: sin él, estarían perdidos ahora. Reflexión: ojalá hubieran mirado la hora antes de salir.

prompt.es: ¿Qué oración une el giro con la situación de hoy?

choices.text: If my neighbour didn't help me, I would still be outside now.
If my neighbour wouldn't have helped me, I would still be outside now.
If my neighbour hadn't helped me, I would still be outside now.

feedback.es: La causa es un hecho pasado, así que va if + had + participio; el resultado de hoy lleva would + verbo base.

origin.text: Un vecino te ayudó ayer y por eso hoy estás dentro de casa.

answer.text: I should have called you earlier

feedback.es: Should have + participio expresa una crítica o un arrepentimiento sobre el pasado.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el giro de la historia.

choices.text: They decided to go to bed.

feedback.es: El giro es lo inesperado: la luz volvió de repente, cuando estaban leyendo a oscuras.

origin.audio: We were reading in the dark because the power had gone out. Suddenly, the lights came back.
